summary.zh: 先写测试再写实现的开发与补测流程
summary.en: Test-first development and test generation across stacks

description.zh: 按红绿重构的节奏推进开发：先写失败的测试，再实现功能，最后整理结构；也支持给已有代码补测试。适配 Jest、Pytest、JUnit、Vitest 与 Mocha，适合需要 mock 依赖或提高覆盖率时使用。
description.en: Drives development in red-green-refactor steps: a failing test first, then the implementation, then cleanup, plus backfilling tests for existing code. Covers Jest, Pytest, JUnit, Vitest and Mocha.
